metadata.description: Ultimatum for Claude Code. The core plugin handles software work. Ultimatum Launch adds business, website, social media, motion graphics and brand film teams, and the Website, E-commerce and App Launch add-ons give each kind of launch its own guided plan.

plugins.name: ultimatum
plugins.description: Workflows for Claude Code. A local router reads each request and loads only the guidance it needs for coding, debugging, CI, interface work, security review and releases. Claims are backed by checks run in the session.

plugins.name: ultimatum-launch
plugins.description: Shared launch teams for Ultimatum: business and brand, website, social media, motion graphics and brand film, with taste and compliance reviewers. Nothing is posted, published, deployed or paid for without your approval.

plugins.name: ultimatum-website-launch
plugins.description: Website Launch for Ultimatum. Plans and runs the launch of a small business, local service, portfolio or creator site: intake, business-type playbooks, page copy, local SEO and a launch checklist. Requires ultimatum-launch.

plugins.name: ultimatum-ecommerce-launch
plugins.description: E-commerce Launch for Ultimatum. Plans and runs an online store launch: platform and theme choice, catalogue and product photos, payments, tax, shipping, policy pages and a first-30-days review. Requires ultimatum-launch.

plugins.name: ultimatum-app-launch
plugins.description: App Launch for Ultimatum. Plans and runs the launch of a web app, mobile app or subscription product: pricing and billing, sign-up and activation, onboarding emails, trust basics and a launch-week plan. Requires ultimatum-launch.
